findings.title: Handle int64 overflow in billing.Total.
findings.rationale: Invoice.Cents is a public int64, and no caller or contract bounds the cumulative value. When the sum exceeds the int64 range, `total += inv.Cents` wraps and returns an invalid total. Use checked arithmetic and return overflow through the API.
